Hi Viorica,

Nothing has shipped yet, so nothing is lost in transit. Your order Shop···· is paid and both Bitfortun BS-4 units are still with us.

Your two units were bought just before the BS-4 drop opened, which was a mistake on our website, so your order is honoured at the price you paid and ships with the launch batch. BitFortun has since finished the firmware update and the drop has opened. The launch batch is listed to ship October 31. These units go out directly from the manufacturer, and the tracking numbers are added to your order as soon as they leave, one number per unit.

We did write to you about this on September 11. Our emails have been landing in junk for some customers, so it is worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so the tracking mail reaches you.

I have also asked a colleague to confirm the dispatch date directly with the manufacturer. The team is offline now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and their answer comes to you by email, so there is nothing you need to do.

Sorry for the long wait on this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
